item.title: Gakuen Gekokujou ~Ore ga Akogare no Ojou-sama o Inran Ochi Saseru made~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura DARKNESS
  • 発売日: 2014-07-25
  • スコア: 6.08/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 学園下克上 ～俺があこがれのお嬢様を淫乱墜ちさせるまで～
  • 英語名: Gakuen Gekokujou Ore ga Akogare no Ojou-sama o Inran Ochi Saseru made

あらすじ

Yuichi’s school used to be girls-only until recently. In fact, Yuichi and his friend Muroi are the only boys in the class and their opinions and wishes are often ignored and they even get bullied by Chiharu, Yuichi’s childhood friend.

The school’s cultural festival is nearing and Yuichi’s class votes for cross-dressing tea house.

item.title: Oyako Mix Ijiri ~Mucchiri Haha to Binyuu na Musume no Inniku Kaihatsu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura DARKNESS
  • 発売日: 2014-05-30
  • スコア: 5.71/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 母娘みっくすいじり ～むっちり母と微乳な娘の淫肉開発
  • 英語名: Oyako Mix Ijiri ~Mucchiri Haha to Binyuu na Musume no Inniku Kaihatsu

あらすじ

The protagonist is a cram school instructor famous for helping his students get excellent results.

One day, he is contacted by his former high school teacher, Miyako, who is looking for someone to tutor her daughter, Kasumi. Since he always had a huge crush on Miyako, he decides to accept her request, whilst keeping his inner feelings hidden.

item.title: Mippei Yarimakuri Elevator ~Konamaiki na Musume ni Oshioki o
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura DARKNESS

  • スコア: 5.79/10 (33 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 密閉やりまくりエレベーター ～小生意気な娘に御仕置きを
  • 英語名: Mippei Yarimakuri Elevator ~Konamaiki na Musume ni Oshioki o

あらすじ

The protagonist, who lost his wife when he was still very young, lives with his only daughter, Saki. Saki is cruel, and looks down on him with disgust.

One day, Saki visits the protagonist at work. There’s an accident, and the two of them wind up trapped together in the elevator.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura DARKNESS

  • スコア: 6.13/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 通勤痴漢電車 アキバ行き ～女子校生に這い寄る無数の手～
  • 英語名: Tsuukin Chikan Densha Akiba Iki Joshikousei ni Haiyoru Musuu no Te

あらすじ

The Commuting Molestation Train:

They say that there’s a certain Akihabara-bound train that attracts men’s desires. It’s an urban legend, a phantom train rumored to actually exist.

Three high school girls board the train in order to find out for themselves if those rumors are true.

item.description:

  • 英語名: Nakadashi Idol Gakuen Housou Kisei Lost Virgin Koukai Live

あらすじ

The protagonist’s father is the head of a major idol production company. He’s been living a normal school life, but one day, his father orders him to begin training as his successor.

As a new manager apprentice, the protagonist is assigned to manage the popular idol group [I Cherry]; its two top idols are also his childhood friends.

item.title: Lock-ON Endless Choukyou Kissa
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura DARKNESS
  • 発売日: 2013-03-29
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Lock-ON エンドレス調教喫茶
  • 英語名: Lock-ON Endless Choukyou Kissa

あらすじ

The protagonist, Shinichi, takes a part-time job at a maid cafe during his summer vacation. Shortly afterword, his classmate Hozumi also starts working there as a waitress.

Hozumi proves to be a boyish, masculine type of girl, who is not well suited to her maid cosplay, and displays little interest in working. She also is selfish and does not listen, and Shinichi becomes increasingly irritated with her.
